reference_probes.edition: 2021-02-04 launch news, not a current layer catalogue or licence

directory_probe.semantics: One listed post-office row, not a unique postcode area or residential address record
directory_probe.duplicate_policy: Keep all source rows; postcode alone is not a unique office identifier. Do not select or merge duplicate rows without reviewed source identity.
directory_probe.date_policy: PDF metadata creation/modification times and retrieval times are not provider-declared assignment validity or a current release date.

rights_review.postal: No explicit product permission for bulk retention, transformation or redistribution was established in the reviewed public operator references. Public directory access is not a licence.
rights_review.cadastre: Official information-provision guidance describes registration and payment for electronic map orders. This does not prove all layers are paid; an exact layer-specific public-field release and licence remain unverified.
rights_review.privacy: The application privacy policy describes free and paid services and personal-information handling, not a dataset redistribution grant.
rights_review.no_blanket_restriction_claim: This bounded review does not establish that all Armenian public data is unavailable or prohibited.
authority_gates: No account creation, paid order, contract acceptance, protected registry query, new public destination, repository or production deployment without additional approval.

authority_boundaries.postal: UPU syntax and HayPost directory metadata do not prove current allocation, delivery or postal polygons.
authority_boundaries.address: A post-office address is not the civic address of every point sharing its postcode.
authority_boundaries.building: Exact building display still requires an independently permitted official identifier or reviewed crosswalk.
authority_boundaries.geometry: No official polygon is inferred from directory points; derived, virtual and none remain distinct.
authority_boundaries.territory: AM country identity and boundaries require independent authority and vintage, never routing or nearest-office inference.
